backend/main.mo: Main actor implementing video/photo sharing platform with access control, blob storage, user profiles, channels, comments, likes, ratings (1-5 stars), and view counts; includes migration support for upgrades.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module that upgrades actor state from OldActor (without ratings) to NewActor (with ratings map), initializing an empty ratings map during the migration.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting implementation of 5-star rating system, average rating display, view counter, and share button with associated files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend files including components, pages, hooks, and configuration files for the video/photo sharing application with YouTube-style UI.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with OKLCH color system defining light and dark theme variables including YouTube-style dark mode with proper contrast and accessibility.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the MediaShare application with root div and module script reference to main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: TanStack Router configuration defining all application routes including home, video/photo galleries, upload pages, player/viewer pages, settings, channel profile, and upgrade routes.
frontend/src/components/AddToPlaylistMod: Empty component file for playlist modal functionality (not yet implemented).
frontend/src/components/AuthButton.tsx: Authentication button component integrating Internet Identity with dropdown menu showing user principal and sign in/out functionality with loading states.
frontend/src/components/ChannelNameDispl: Component displaying clickable channel name with loading skeleton, showing truncated principal if no custom channel name exists, linking to channel profile page.
frontend/src/components/CommentSection.t: Displays a comment section for videos with a form to add new comments (authenticated users only) and a list of existing comments with author avatars and timestamps.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main layout component with sticky header (logo, search, upload, auth), collapsible sidebar, main content area, and footer with social links.
frontend/src/components/PhotoCard.tsx: Card component displaying a photo thumbnail, title, uploader channel name, and upload date with click navigation to photo detail page.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Modal dialog that prompts authenticated users without a profile to enter their name (required) and optional channel name (3-30 characters).
frontend/src/components/ShareButton.tsx: Button component that copies the current page URL to clipboard and shows a toast notification on success or failure.
frontend/src/components/Sidebar.tsx: Responsive sidebar navigation with Home, Trending, and Library links; includes mobile overlay and close button with active route highlighting.
frontend/src/components/TagInput.tsx: Input component for managing tags with keyboard support (Enter/comma to add, Backspace to remove) and removable badge display.
frontend/src/components/ThumbnailSelecto: Component for selecting video thumbnails either from auto-generated frames at 10/30/50/70% positions or uploading a custom image (JPEG/PNG, max 5MB) with validation and upload progress.
frontend/src/components/UpgradePrompt.ts: Displays a promotional card encouraging free-tier users to upgrade to premium, showing benefits like unlimited uploads, 4K quality, and priority support with a navigation button to the upgrade page.
frontend/src/components/VideoCard.tsx: Renders video cards in default or compact variants with thumbnail, title, channel name, view count, and upload time; includes time-ago formatting and navigation to video detail page on click.
frontend/src/components/VideoEditModal.t: Modal dialog with tabs for editing video details (title, description, tags) and managing thumbnails; includes form validation, change detection, and save/remove functionality.
frontend/src/components/VideoQualitySele: Dropdown menu component for selecting video quality (auto, 360p, 480p, 720p, 1080p) with visual indication of current selection and a note about browser limitations.
frontend/src/components/VideoRating.tsx: Interactive 5-star rating component allowing authenticated users to rate videos, displaying user's current rating with hover effects and integrating with VideoRatingDisplay for average ratings.
frontend/src/components/VideoRatingDispl: Read-only display component showing average star rating with visual stars (full, half, empty) and total rating count for a video.
frontend/src/components/VideoSettings.ts: Card component for managing video thumbnail settings, allowing users to view current thumbnail, add/change thumbnail via ThumbnailSelector, or remove existing thumbnail.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React Query hook that creates and manages the backend actor instance based on Internet Identity authentication state, handling both authenticated and anonymous actors with automatic query invalidation on identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAddComment.ts: Mutation hook for adding comments to videos, invalidating related queries on success and showing appropriate toast notifications for success or authentication errors.
frontend/src/hooks/useAddVideoToPlaylist: Empty file placeholder for adding videos to playlists functionality.
frontend/src/hooks/useAverageRating.ts: Query hook that fetches the average rating for a specific video using the actor instance.
frontend/src/hooks/useChannelName.ts: React Query hook that fetches a channel name for a given Principal, with 5-minute caching and fallback to principal string if actor unavailable.
frontend/src/hooks/useComments.ts: React Query hook that fetches comments for a specific video ID from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useCreatePlaylist.ts: Empty file placeholder for playlist creation functionality.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetCallerUserProfi: React Query hook that fetches the current authenticated user's profile, with custom loading state that accounts for actor initialization.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetUserRating.ts: React Query hook that fetches the authenticated user's rating for a specific video from their ratings list.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetUserSubscriptio: React Query hook that returns subscription tier and features; currently returns free tier as default with TODO for backend implementation.
frontend/src/hooks/useIncrementPhotoView: Empty file placeholder for photo view increment functionality.
frontend/src/hooks/useIncrementVideoView: React Query mutation hook that increments video view count and invalidates related queries, with silent error handling.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides React context and hooks for Internet Identity authentication, managing login state, identity persistence, and delegation validity with configurable AuthClient options.
frontend/src/hooks/useMarkThumbnailGener: React Query mutation hook that marks a video thumbnail as generated with an ExternalBlob, showing toast notifications and invalidating video queries.
frontend/src/hooks/usePhoto.ts: React Query hook that fetches a single photo by ID from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/usePhotos.ts: React Query hook that fetches a list of photo metadata from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/usePhotoUpload.ts: React Query mutation hook that uploads photos by converting File to Uint8Array, tracking upload progress, and showing toast notifications.
frontend/src/hooks/usePlaylist.ts: Empty file placeholder for single playlist functionality.
frontend/src/hooks/usePlaylists.ts: Empty file placeholder for playlists list functionality.
frontend/src/hooks/useRateVideo.ts: React Query mutation hook that submits video ratings (1-5 stars) and invalidates all rating-related queries, with authentication error handling.
frontend/src/hooks/useRemoveThumbnail.ts: React Query mutation hook that removes a video thumbnail with authorization checks and toast notifications.
frontend/src/hooks/useRemoveVideoFromPla: Empty file placeholder for removing videos from playlists.
frontend/src/hooks/useSaveCallerUserProf: React Query mutation hook that saves the current user's profile and invalidates profile and channel name queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useSearchVideos.ts: React Query hook that searches videos by term and fetches full video data for each result, enabled only when search term is non-empty.
frontend/src/hooks/useSetChannelName.ts: React Query mutation hook that sets channel name with 3-30 character validation and invalidates channel-related queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useSetCustomThumbnail: React Query mutation hook that uploads custom video thumbnails with progress tracking using ExternalBlob's upload progress callback.
frontend/src/hooks/useSubscribe.ts: React Query mutation hook placeholder for channel subscription that currently throws 'coming soon' error until backend is implemented.
frontend/src/hooks/useSubscriptionStatus: React Query hook that checks if user is subscribed to a channel; currently returns false as placeholder until backend implements subscriptions.
frontend/src/hooks/useTotalRatings.ts: React Query hook that fetches the total number of ratings for a video and converts BigInt to number.
frontend/src/hooks/useUpdateVideo.ts: React Query mutation hook that updates video title, description, and tags with authorization checks and query invalidation.
frontend/src/hooks/useUpgradeAccount.ts: React Query mutation hook placeholder for account upgrade to premium that currently throws not-implemented error with simulated delay.
frontend/src/hooks/useUserStats.ts: React Query hook that fetches user statistics for a given Principal with 5-minute cache duration.
frontend/src/hooks/useVideo.ts: React Query hook that fetches a single video by ID using the actor's getVideo method, enabled only when actor and videoId are available.
frontend/src/hooks/useVideoLike.ts: React Query mutation hook for liking videos that invalidates video queries on success and displays appropriate toast messages for various error states.
frontend/src/hooks/useVideos.ts: React Query hook that fetches the list of all videos using the actor's listVideos method, enabled only when actor is available.
frontend/src/hooks/useVideoUpload.ts: React Query mutation hook that handles video file upload with progress tracking, converts files to Uint8Array/ExternalBlob, and provides detailed error handling with typed error states.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light and dark theme colors, including sidebar, chart, and UI component tokens using OKLCH color space.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query and Internet Identity providers, then renders the App component into the root DOM element.
frontend/src/pages/ChannelProfile.tsx: Channel profile page that displays user information, statistics, and filters videos/photos by uploader principal, with tabs for content organization and error handling for invalid principals.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Home page component that displays a grid of video cards sorted by upload time in descending order, with loading and empty states.
frontend/src/pages/PhotoGallery.tsx: Photo gallery page with search functionality (debounced) that displays photos in a responsive grid, filtering by title and description.
frontend/src/pages/PhotoViewer.tsx: Photo detail viewer that converts Uint8Array photo data to blob URL for display, shows metadata, and handles cleanup of object URLs on unmount.
frontend/src/pages/PlaylistDetail.tsx: Empty file placeholder for playlist detail page functionality.
frontend/src/pages/Playlists.tsx: Empty file placeholder for playlists page functionality.
frontend/src/pages/Settings.tsx: Settings page component that allows authenticated users to manage their profile (name, channel name) and view subscription status with upgrade prompts for free-tier users.
frontend/src/pages/Upgrade.tsx: Upgrade page component displaying free vs premium tier comparison cards with feature lists and upgrade button for authenticated users to purchase premium subscriptions.
frontend/src/pages/UploadPhoto.tsx: Photo upload page with form for title/description, file selection with preview, upload progress tracking, and success/error states for authenticated users.
frontend/src/pages/UploadVideo.tsx: Video upload page with validation (format, 500MB limit), title/description/tags input, thumbnail selection, upload progress, and success/retry handling for authenticated users.
frontend/src/pages/VideoGallery.tsx: Video gallery page displaying all videos in a grid layout with debounced search functionality to filter videos by title or description.
frontend/src/pages/VideoPlayer.tsx: Video player page with streaming playback, like/subscribe buttons, view count tracking, expandable description, comments section, and related videos sidebar.
frontend/src/utils/formatters.ts: Utility functions for formatting BigInt view counts into human-readable strings (K, M, B) and converting nanosecond timestamps into relative time strings (e.g., '2 hours ago').
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: URL parameter parsing utilities supporting both standard query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence for maintaining state across navigation and functions to clear sensitive parameters from URLs.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom color scheme using OKLCH color space, extended theme with sidebar/chart colors, custom animations (accordion), and Inter font family setup.
project_state.json: Project metadata for a YouTube-style video platform built on Internet Computer with Motoko, tracking implemented features (5-star ratings, view counter, share button) and pending feature requests for backend rating storage.
